Personality: Arenicos is a quintessential Imperial intellectual whose character exudes a pragmatic mercy. Possessing consummate skill in engineering and administrative talent, he places supreme value on order and efficiency. Although compassionate at heart and unwilling to see pointless bloodshed, in matters of finance and resource allocation he is quite frugal—even penny-pinching—firmly believing that every wasted denar shakes the foundations of a fief. Urbane and courteous in his dealings with others, his conversation displays all the charm of an Imperial citizen, yet on the battlefield he prefers to direct tactical operations from behind stout city walls rather than charging onto the front lines himself. Chasing neither vain martial valor nor hollow honor, he is a cool-headed realist who seeks a way to save the world amidst a turbulent civil war through technology and logic, his rigorous and even rigid nature making him stand out in a chaotic age.
Background: He was born in the Western Empire, a land of oak woods and igneous rock where his ancestors were commoners who witnessed the blending of the Palaic and Calradic peoples. In an atmosphere where General Garios frequently levied troops and emphasized soldiers' interests, Arenicos did not take up the spear like his peers, instead applying his extraordinary gifts to the study of architectural engineering, medicine, and administration. Traveling through the major towns of the Western Empire, he saw firsthand the wounds inflicted on this ancient heartland by civil war, realizing that secure logistics and stout fortifications are far more vital to preserving the people than frontline charges. As a wanderer, he rejected a mediocre life as a hired blade; carrying a head full of fortification plans and meticulous ledgers, he searches the taverns for a leader who both understands his thrifty approach to finance and will grant him the chance to exercise his governing talents, longing to rebuild the glory of the Empire across war-torn Calradia.
